title: Billing-Error Corrections on the Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement Ledger
content:
**Correction standard.** A charge posted in error on a Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement is reversed in full — 100 percent of the charge — with a billing-error correction credit referencing that charge. A billing-error correction is given in any status other than reserved or reservation cancelled and does not count against the courtesy allowance. A charge that has already been waived or corrected is not credited again.

## When a charge is in error

| Charge | It is in error when |
|---|---|
| Late fee | the ledger shows payments dated on or before the period's last grace day that cover the period's rent |
| Second late fee | the ledger shows payments dated before the class's second-late-fee day (that number of calendar days after the due date), covering the period's rent |
| Rent charge | a second rent charge exists for the same billing period |
| Rent charge | it was posted for a period starting on or after the planned vacate date of a moving out rental |

## Condition, judgement, result

- **Condition:** a charge matches a row of the table above, the agreement is not reserved or reservation cancelled, and the charge carries no earlier courtesy waiver or correction.
- **Judgement:** the charge is a billing error.
- **Result:** one billing-error correction credit for the whole charge, referencing it; the courtesy allowance of the agreement is unchanged.

## Worked cases (hypothetical, 5-day grace period, rent due 1 June)

- Rent paid in full on 6 June and a late fee posted on 8 June: the payment is dated on the last grace day and covers the rent, so the late fee is an error and is credited in full.
- Rent paid in full on 7 June and a late fee posted on 8 June: the payment is dated after the last grace day, so this table does not make the late fee an error.
- Two rent charges for the period starting 1 June: the second is an error.
- A moving out rental with a planned vacate date of 20 June charged rent for a period starting 1 July: that rent charge is an error.
